facts.fact: The Communications Authority consultation states that the ICT Sector Policy Guidelines, 2020 (also called National ICT policy guidelines, 2020) direct government agencies to promote and license private investment in carrier-neutral data centres; no adoption date beyond 2020 is given and the document's published date is 2026-09-01.

note: One fact on the named sector policy guidelines; the CA 2023-2027 strategic plan is an institution-plan, no fact.
